summary: Log lines show a rapid degradation of the external tax service latency, causing the checkout service thread pool to saturate, upstream gateway 504 responses, and ultimately 503 Server Busy rejections. A recent deployment introduced a 60 s default timeout for the tax provider.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:07:00Z ERROR [checkout-service] Thread starvation: Incoming checkout requests rejected with 503 Server Busy
evidence.interpretation: Indicates that all worker threads are blocked, leading to request rejections.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:06:30Z ERROR [checkout-service] Upstream API gateway returned 504 GATEWAY_TIMEOUT on /api/v1/checkout
evidence.interpretation: Shows a downstream timeout from the API gateway, likely caused by delayed upstream calls.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:06:00Z WARN [checkout-service] Worker thread pool saturation: 30/30 threads blocked waiting on tax service response
evidence.interpretation: Thread pool fully occupied waiting for the tax service, a bottleneck point.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:00Z WARN [checkout-service] External tax service latency degraded to 25,000ms
evidence.interpretation: Tax service response time spiked to 25 s, far exceeding normal latency.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:04:00Z INFO [checkout-service] Deploy commit 9a0b1c: Integrated external tax calculation provider with 60s default timeout
evidence.interpretation: Deployment introduced a new tax provider with a 60 s timeout setting.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:04:25Z INFO [checkout-service] [tls] Ingress TLS cert check completed (valid for 89 days) - distractor
evidence.interpretation: TLS check unrelated to the observed performance issue.
Baseline response time before the latency degradation began.
